Готу кола.about: Centella: cognition = placebo; cheerfulness is higher, anger is lower; wound healing - 4 RCT.
Готу кола.caution: Gotu kola (Centella asiatica) is an adaptogen from Ayurveda. For cognitive function: there is evidence, but the quality of RCT is often low. For venous insufficiency: data available. Safe in standard doses (60-240 mg/day). Caution: Hepatotoxicity in rare cases.
Готу кола.food_sources: The leaves of Centella asiatica are eaten as greens in Asia; clinical doses are from a standardized extract.
Готу кола.guidelines: MA 2017 (5 RCT): cognition = placebo; cheerfulness SMD 0.71, anger −0.81 (1 hour). SR 2022: healing - 4 RCT.
Готу кола.how_to_choose: Extract with standardization for triterpenes (asiaticoside), 300-600 mg in courses; If you have liver problems, do not take it.
mechs: Triterpenes (asiaticoside): microcirculation and venous tone, weak GABA modulation
Venous insufficiency is moderate; cognition/sleep—weak data
Mood modulation: cheerfulness and reduction of irritability
Cheerfulness is higher (SMD 0.71), anger is lower (−0.81) after 1 hour; cognition without effect
Angiogenesis and collagen I synthesis (wound healing)
Healing: angiogenesis via collagen I/FGF/VEGF; 4 RCT without meta-analysis
Готу кола.myths: Nootropic herb - no difference from placebo in all domains of cognition. “Heals wounds from the inside” - 4 small RCTs without meta-analysis. Rare hepatotoxicity.
